title: What's It Doing?
text:
What's It Doing?. Is it? Isn't it? I ran this continuously for a month in my 11' x 12' bedroom. I've checked the filter a couple times and it appears to be nearly as clean as the day I got the purifier. I made sure to close the door quickly, spent 12+ hours at a time in the room and to be completely honest I haven't detected any difference in the air quality/feel of the room with this running and without.
Construction seems decent, it's sturdy and things snap in and out with satisfying solid sounds. Moving this I found next to impossible, the handle is shallow and slopes at the wrong angle to get a good grip. There's also nothing inside the hole to grab onto, it's just a rectangular hole in the back. I'm disabled and almost dropped it twice just moving it to the back of the house. There's a UV light inside to kill mold and bacteria. I know the technology works, the local hospital has them in every room and our A/C vendor keeps trying to sell us one. When you turn on the UV light a half ring across the face of the unit lights up BRIGHT blue. You can't dim the light and there's no built in cover. You're not going to want to run the UV light when you're trying to sleep. In the past I've slept with lights on in the room (usually hospitals) and I can't stand this on when I'm trying to sleep. Speaking of sleep. You won't want to run this on anything but low if you're using this in a bedroom. Medium and high move a LOT of air (be sure to keep away from drapes) and make a LOT of noise. On the subject of noise. In the course of the month I've been testing this unit the fan, on low, has gotten almost twice as loud as it was when I first plugged it in. I've vacuumed the filter and checked the visible parts of the unit over and it seems fine so the fan's just gotten noisier which I find exceptionally annoying as I have very sensitive hearing.
In the end? I don't know what if anything this is doing beyond running air through the device. I don't feel healthier. The air doesn't feel healthier. My eyes and sinuses bother me exactly as much as they did before this got here. I haven't seen or felt any benefit from this room air purifier.
